The corner mark is not switched by picking another roster bot in this recording. Silhouette and colour changes come from the appearance drawer.
grokbot-desktop-ctl wave, celebrate, spin, and say are not shown.

tools/render-preview.py can still redraw the chrome offline. preview.png in this tree is the on-device frame, not that render.

The motion and layout pass after 91f8f75e (single bubble card with an appearance page, non-modal bubble, OKLCH morphs, squash and stretch, reduce-motion, compact idle window, QtQuick.Shapes mark) was checked with ./tests/run and an offscreen Qt 6.12 harness with stubbed Quickshell modules, rendered on Mesa llvmpipe. It has not been recorded on a live Omarchy desktop, and preview.png and the demo video predate it.

The fourteen shapes and their eyes are measured from a phone screenshot of Grok Bot's Avatar > Shape sheet; the eleven colours match that sheet, its dark-mode version (where black is drawn white), and the values Grok Bot stores. Grok Bot's dark-mode roster confirms the names blob (the round shape: OmaBot, Afterglow, .promo) and pebble (the lumpy round shape: Middle Farm Admin, shown without the picker's pumpkin stem); the other shapes are named for how they look. A 28-second 60fps recording of the picker shows shape and colour changes landing between two frames, a 55% press dim, the selection ring jumping with no transition, and an avatar that neither breathes, bobs, nor blinks at rest while its eyes drift; the companion now matches those. The recording does not show how Grok Bot animates a switch between bots, its gaze easing, or any blink timing, so the bot-switch morph, the pointer easing, and Playful's blinks remain this plugin's own.

A first pass on the owner's own Omarchy laptop after 2db702d (a screenshot, not a recording) shows the companion loaded by the real shell: the orange teardrop with its eyes cut through to the wallpaper, the bubble with Bob's header, the pinned Bob, OmaBot, Poteto and Family Finances chips and the +11 expander, and an agent-mode reply from Grok (grok --no-auto-update -p) answering as Bob. The Omarchy version, output scale, bot switching, motion, dodge and drag were not captured in it.
